capabilities: Send a whole note as a draft
Strip front matter from the sent note
Store the API key and workspace ID in settings
extras: The plugin never publishes anything; the API key is stored as plain text in the plugin's data.json. Install is manual, by copying main.js and manifest.json into the plugins folder.
problem: Moving text from an Obsidian note into a social media scheduler means copying and pasting it by hand.
summary: Sends a note or the selected text from Obsidian to SolMarrow as a social media draft for later editing and scheduling.
